sources.title: oddadmix (Ahmed Wasfy) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: From-scratch Arabic LMs (0.5M-50M) finetuned into bidirectional translators across 5 language pairs. Identical recipe at every rung; v1 and v2 bases.

sources.title: oddadmix/Nawah-VL-25M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The language model is oddadmix/Emhotob-25M-v2, trained from scratch on Arabic. The vision tower is SigLIP2 as distributed in LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M, used unmodified and frozen; those weights remain LiquidAI's and their licence terms apply to that component.
